note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9494 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires deleting all retained stale routes of an AFI/SAFI if its LLST timer expires before the session is re-established. In handleLLSTExpired, while syncing==false, expiring a family removes it from staleFamilies and llgrFamilies, dispatches onLLGRFamilyExpired(expiredSource, fam) -> request bgp rib source purge-stale for that family, and fires onLLGRComplete -> release-routes when the last family expires. All 4 tag bindings across 3 functions verified: TestLLSTTimerExpiry_SingleFamily verifies single-family expiry leaves sibling active; TestRFC9494LLSTExpiryDeletesTheFamilysStaleRoutes drives production wireStateCallbacks and asserts exact IPv4 source purge-stale with no IPv6 purge; TestRFC9494DelayedDownPreservesLLSTDeadlines (positive and negative tags) verifies in the real RIB with synctest that each family remains at stale-level 2 one nanosecond before its deadline (even after its sibling expires) and disappears at its exact deadline.
